Chapter 1: Journeys in the Misty Vale

Between adventures the heroes cross the Misty Vale on foot, from the farmland around Outskirt to the diseased Magna Woods, the dark Iron Forest, the leech-ridden Haunted Marshes and the wind-scoured foot of the mountains. Each region has its own perils and chance meetings: Leanara's spy Medvin among friendly farmers, rattling skeleton toll-keepers, the suspicious dragon knight Tylos, elven hunters seeking a stolen friend, Sathmog cultists summoning a demon, Maladûk's nervous orcs, harpies, a manticore, a giant, a griffon and the passing shadow of a dragon. Travel well and the vale gives up rumours, allies and hidden caches; travel carelessly and the road itself becomes the adventure.
